II · The same page

Someone else is on the same page.

III · Reflections

No followers. No likes. Just reflections.

On Together, you show up as a reflection: a picture you choose to share, the sentence you're living by this week, and a thought bubble like “library on Friday?”. Nobody counts likes. You see who's studying what nearby, and you write to them.

Move your cursor. The painting turns toward you.

Appendix · Privacy

Privacy policy

Last updated 1 October 2026 · Mirror browser extension, version 2.2 and later, and this website

In short

  • Your new tab (tasks, deadlines, goals, camera recording) stays in your browser. We never receive it.
  • Together is optional. If you join, we store what you choose to share there, so other confirmed students can see it.
  • No ads, no analytics, no trackers. We never sell your data.
  • You can delete your Together data any time in Mirror's Settings.
1

Who is responsible

Mirror is made by Iona Dzidzishvili, Berlin, Germany. For anything about your data, write to iona.dzidzishvili@gmail.com.

2

What stays on your device

These are saved only in your browser's extension storage and are never sent to us:

  • Your mantra, north stars, today's and this week's tasks, deadlines, energy level and settings.
  • Your camera image and your recorded photo or video. The camera is used only to show your reflection on the new tab.
  • Your Anthropic API key, if you add one.

Uninstalling Mirror removes this data from your browser.

3

What we store if you join Together

Together is the optional community part of Mirror for students in Berlin. When you join, we store:

Your university email
To check that you study in Berlin and to sign you in with a one-time code. Other users never see it.
Your card
Display name, university, faculty, your reflection line, the north star in focus, energy level, how many weekly tasks you finished (the number only), playlist link, thought bubble and when you were last active. Other confirmed students see it. You can stop sharing it in Settings.
Your picture or clip
Only if you turn on “Show my picture”. A small copy is stored as a file that can only be opened with its exact link, and it is shown on your card. Turning it off deletes it.
What you post
Events, “going” marks, groups, discussion posts, comments and job posts, visible to other members. Private messages, visible only to you and the person you write to.
Technical data
A random account ID and your sign-in session. Our servers process your IP address to deliver requests and may keep it briefly in security logs.
4

Services that process data for us

  • Supabase hosts the Together database, sign-in and picture storage on servers in Frankfurt, Germany.
  • An email delivery service sends your sign-in code to your university email.
  • Google Fonts: Mirror's pages and this website load their fonts from Google, which receives your IP address when they load.
  • Anthropic, only if you add your own API key: your name, mantra, north star, energy and today's tasks are sent from your browser directly to Anthropic to write your reflection line, under your own Anthropic account.
5

This website

This website sets no cookies and uses no analytics or tracking. Its pictures are part of the page itself. The fonts come from Google Fonts (see section 4), and the company hosting the website may keep standard server logs, such as your IP address and the time of your visit, for security.

6

Why we may use it (legal basis)

  • To provide Together after you ask to join: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR.
  • Showing your picture: your consent, Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR. You can withdraw it any time by turning it off.
  • Keeping Together and this website safe (sign-in checks, limits against spam, security logs): our legitimate interest, Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.
7

How long we keep it

We keep your Together data while you use Together. In Mirror's Settings, Delete my Together data immediately removes your card, picture, posts, comments, messages, events and groups. Comments other people wrote under your posts are removed with your posts. Your email address stays in the sign-in list until you ask us to remove it; we do that within 30 days.

8

Your rights

You can ask us for a copy of your data, to correct it, to delete it, to limit how we use it, and to receive it in a portable format, and you can object to its use. Write to the address in section 1. You can also complain to a data protection authority, for example the Berliner Beauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit.

9

What we never do

  • We don't sell or rent your data, and we don't show ads.
  • We don't use analytics or tracking tools, and we don't read your browsing history.
  • We don't use your data for anything unrelated to Mirror, or to decide creditworthiness or lending.

Mirror's use of data complies with the Chrome Web Store User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

10

Age

Together is for university students. It is not meant for anyone under 16.

11

Changes

If this policy changes, we update the date at the top. Important changes are also announced in Together.
